metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: Mean sampled pairwise embedding cosine mapped to [0,1]; approximately 0.5 means mean cosine zero. Measures directional concentration only, not recommendation diversity, satisfaction, or simulator traits. Zero vectors use F.normalize semantics; null means fewer than two catalog embeddings.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean deployed positive-minus-negative score on valid training positions. Depends on score scale; null means no valid observations.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Empirical lower tenth percentile of deployed training-pair margins; scale dependent.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of valid supplied training pairs where the negative strictly outscores the positive.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of deployed training-pair margins below eps=0.5; scale dependent and not calibrated across models.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Counts valid low-margin and wrong-rank positions. Category lists remain empty because category observations are unavailable.
metric_definitions.residual_fixed_candidate_comparison: Paired comparison on identical supplied positive/negative training candidates. Residual-off scores use view.predict_score_base when provided, or the first D features dotted with raw candidate embeddings when feature_layout='sasrec_recent_concat' is explicitly declared. Feature width alone does not establish scoring semantics. Deployed scores use view.predict_score. Positive rank is 1 or 2 with positive-first ties. These training-pair diagnostics are not pinned validation HR@10 or full-catalog ranks and do not select coefficients.
metric_definitions.unavailable_observations: Null denotes unavailable evidence. Histories and embedding similarity do not establish ownership, dislike, satisfaction, compatibility, complementarity, redundancy, current need, or simulator traits.
